cells.gaps: The 87% is mobile money reach among adults, as an opinion writer describes the survey; the survey's 90% financially included is an inclusion share. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: Restaged under messages-for-bill 131 (no): the 90% financially included (SOM-004, SOM-005) no longer counts, but the 2026 Financial Access Survey puts mobile money reach at 87% of adults (SOM-002, SOM-003), over four in five, so 4 stands.
